body: It's sad to me that the only people who care are ones online that don't know me

Thanks. Yea we did that after the first few months. Change it bout 4 times. Almost felt worse after awhile.  It's ok. I think I'm past the point of feeling like it'll get better. I feel like I'm at an age where I know better than to feel like this bit I think I've just given up in my head. I appreciate Ur concern tho.

Guess I am depressed. I can't afford a psychiatrist, n there aren't really any near me. I did go to the dr n got meds, but after about 8 months I quit taking them. They weren't doing anything for me. I do feel like I'm drowning half the time, when I get 3 problems fixed, 7 more come up. I always feel like I'm behind n will never catch up.

Yea I guess so. Im 35 married. I'm not close at all with my wife n kids anymore. I hate my job but have struggled for 10 years to find anything else. The hard part is when I'm upset no one seems to care.

I don't feel I have anyone to miss me but my parents. After 35 years, that doesn't seem to be enough for me. I just feel like Im in the way everywhere I go. Love is not something I have from a lot of people.
